name: SenseICs Corporation
old_description: SenseICs is dedicated to reimagining the status quo, designing and building next-generation integrated circuits, and delivering the best possible solutions to meet the needs of our customers.
about:
SenseICs Corporation is based in Columbus, Ohio, at 1275 Kinnear Road. The company was co-founded by Ramy Tantawy, PhD, and Dale Shane Smith, PhD. Both bring decades of mixed-signal integrated circuit design experience from Intel, Micron, Forza Silicon, and Ohio State University's Electroscience Lab. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

As a fabless semiconductor provider, SenseICs designs and develops silicon-verified integrated circuits and microelectronics hardware. Its core technologies include high dynamic range readout integrated circuits (HDR ROICs), tamper-resistant ICs, and wide-band gallium nitride power amplifiers. The company offers full turnkey services from design and tape-out through packaging and test, and supplies evaluation hardware and development kits. Fabrication is typically conducted via multi-project wafer runs with foundry partners such as SkyWater, GlobalFoundries, Tower Semiconductor, and onsemi.

SenseICs serves high-energy physics experiments, medical imaging electronics, and defense and commercial markets. Its customer base includes NASA, the U.S. Navy, Air Force, Army Research Laboratory, CERN, Jefferson Lab, and academic partners at The Ohio State University. The company collaborates closely with OSU's ElectroScience Laboratory, Nanotech West Lab, and Department of Physics.

The company emphasizes a multidisciplinary approach and a culture summarized by the acronym STRIDE (Staying Curious, Trust, Resilience, Innovation, Diversity, Excellence). It positions its differentiation on radiation-hardening by design for environments exceeding 100 Mrad total ionizing dose, trusted microelectronics, and a team with deep expertise in mixed-signal IC design, RF, and high-speed communication.
